modal.title: Title
modal.title_help: Following a feed? Leave this empty to use the feed's own title.
modal.cover_help: Square works best, at least 1400 × 1400 pixels. JPEG, PNG or WebP.
modal.hosts_help: Hosts can publish episodes and edit this show.
modal.feed_url_help: For a show hosted elsewhere (Buzzsprout, Transistor, Spotify for Creators…). Its episodes are added here, each with a discussion. Leave empty to host the show on this forum.
modal.tag_help: The tag every episode's discussion starts in.
modal.audio_help: MP3, M4A or Ogg. A link must point at the audio file itself.
modal.notes_help: Becomes the first post of the episode's discussion.
modal.chapters_help: One per line, a time then a title: 12:30 The main story
modal.server_limit: The server refused a file this big. Its upload limit (the web server's body size, and PHP's upload_max_filesize and post_max_size) must be raised, or link to the file instead.
modal.delete_show_confirm: Delete this show? Its episodes' discussions stay, as ordinary discussions.
modal.delete_episode_confirm: Delete this episode? Its discussion is hidden and can be restored.

settings.notify_new_episode: Someone publishes an episode of a show I follow

settings.fetch_minutes_help: Earshot checks a feed at most this often. An unchanged feed costs one small request.
settings.backlog: Episodes to bring in when a feed is first followed
settings.backlog_help: The latest episodes only, so following a show with years of episodes does not flood the forum. Later episodes are always added.
settings.max_audio_mb_help: PHP's upload_max_filesize and post_max_size, and your web server's body limit, must allow this too.

api.audio_invalid: That is not an MP3, M4A or Ogg audio file.
